posts.name: chainsawrabbit
posts.cooked:
Yeah, area damage is The Sentinels' natural predator.  Tonight's game was The Naturalist, The Sentinels, Omnitron-X, and Tempest versus Skinwalker GloomWeaver.  GloomWeaver's start was pretty chump, ground through it pretty fast, but the second he flipped... Holy.  Crap.  The Sentinels went down HARD.  If something is targeting them individually, Dr. Medico is amazing at keeping his teammates in fighting shape, but the second the damage gets too far ahead of him, all he can really do is scratch his ass of pure positive energy while his teammates get paddled.  The four of them together are a great combination of healing/tanking/damage/utility, but the second corner of that square is gone, it gets ugly fast.

The Idealist's Incapacitated side disturbs me in ways I do not yet understand.

We did have some interaction questions between The Sentinesl and GloomWeaver's Pin cards, but we figured it worked as such:

When determining "most cards in play" or "fewest cards in play", treat The Sentinels as a single Hero.  However, when it comes to assigning damage from a Pin (or similar effect), the player chooses which Sentinel takes it.
